config.value: Damaged package policy: if an item arrives damaged, the customer has 30 days from delivery to request a replacement, no receipt required. Replacements ship free via express. Late delivery policy: if a package is more than 2 days past its estimated delivery window, the customer is eligible for a 10 percent credit on that order, applied automatically at request. Lost package policy: a package is considered lost if it has shown no tracking movement for 7 consecutive days; the customer may request a full refund or a reshipment.
